_comment: Recorded Decision candidates per Discussion id, standing in for the extraction model. Candidates marked 'not verbatim' must be rejected by the quote check.

rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.choice: Run schema changes online by stepping the descriptor through delete-only and write-only states, one lease-guarded version at a time
rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.rationale: Waiting for every node to hold a lease on the new descriptor version means at most two versions are in use at once.
alternatives_rejected: Run schema changes synchronously inside the issuing transaction
rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.quote: Each state transition waits for all nodes to hold a lease on the new descriptor version, so at most two versions of a descriptor are in use at any time.

rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.choice: Start the backfill in SchemaChanger.runBackfill only after every node has seen the write-only state
rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.rationale: Otherwise a node could write a row that the backfill misses.
rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.quote: The backfill is run by `SchemaChanger.runBackfill` once all nodes have seen the write-only state, so that no node can write a row the backfill misses.

rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.choice: Run schema changes synchronously in the issuing transaction
rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.rationale: not verbatim: the RFC says the opposite.
rfc:20151014_online_schema_change.quote: Schema changes always run synchronously inside the issuing transaction.

rfc:20210115_new_schema_changer.choice: Gate the declarative schema changer behind the sql.defaults.use_declarative_schema_changer cluster setting during rollout
rfc:20210115_new_schema_changer.rationale: It can then be enabled statement by statement and disabled in production without a binary change if a bug is found.
rfc:20210115_new_schema_changer.quote: The declarative schema changer is gated by the `sql.defaults.use_declarative_schema_changer` cluster setting so that it can be enabled statement by statement and disabled in production if a bug is found, without a binary change.

rfc:20210115_new_schema_changer.choice: Execute the statement phase of a declarative schema change inside the user's transaction, in scrun.RunStatementPhase
rfc:20210115_new_schema_changer.rationale: Later statements in the same transaction must observe the change.
rfc:20210115_new_schema_changer.quote: `scrun.RunStatementPhase` executes the statement phase inside the user's transaction so that later statements in the same transaction observe the change.

rfc:20200909_transactional_schema_change.choice: Run each schema change statement of an explicit transaction in scrun.RunStatementPhase as a child transaction that commits before the user's transaction
rfc:20200909_transactional_schema_change.rationale: A failed backfill then never rolls back the user's other writes.
alternatives_rejected: Run the whole schema change inside the user's transaction
rfc:20200909_transactional_schema_change.quote: `scrun.RunStatementPhase` runs each schema change statement in a child transaction that commits before the user's transaction, so a failed backfill never rolls back the user's other writes.

pr:98100.choice: Retry schema change jobs with exponential backoff capped by schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff instead of retrying immediately
pr:98100.rationale: A fixed retry interval either retries too aggressively during long outages or too slowly after short ones, and immediate retries hot-looped when a descriptor was offline.
pr:98100.quote: We chose a capped exponential backoff rather than a fixed retry interval because a fixed interval either retries too aggressively during long outages or too slowly after short ones.

pr:98100.choice: Default the schema change retry backoff cap to 20 seconds
pr:98100.rationale: A 20 second cap keeps a stuck job visible without hammering the cluster.
pr:98100.quote: Capping the backoff at 20 seconds keeps a stuck job visible in SHOW JOBS without hammering the cluster.

pr:98100.rationale: not verbatim: a paraphrase of the description.
pr:98100.quote: We picked exponential backoff since fixed intervals are bad.

pr:101200.choice: Treat descriptor validation errors as permanent schema change errors
pr:101200.rationale: Validation errors cannot be fixed by retrying, so the job should fail instead of spinning until the backoff cap.
pr:101200.quote: Descriptor validation errors cannot be fixed by retrying, so the schema changer should stop retrying and fail the job instead of spinning until the backoff cap.

pr:101200.choice: Fail the job on descriptor validation errors
pr:101200.rationale: not verbatim: the case differs from the description.
pr:101200.quote: the Schema Changer should stop retrying and fail the job instead of spinning until the backoff cap.

pr:101450.choice: Keep retrying schema change jobs on descriptor validation errors instead of treating them as permanent
pr:101450.rationale: Descriptors can fail validation transiently while the cluster version gate is crossed during upgrades.
pr:101450.quote: During upgrades, descriptors can fail validation transiently while the cluster version gate is being crossed, so treating validation errors as permanent failed jobs that would have succeeded on retry.

pr:101450.choice: Treat descriptor validation errors as permanent
pr:101450.rationale: not verbatim here: the quote is real but comes from a different Discussion (#101200).
pr:101450.quote: Descriptor validation errors cannot be fixed by retrying, so the schema changer should stop retrying and fail the job instead of spinning until the backoff cap.

pr:104500.choice: Treat descriptor validation errors as permanent only once the cluster version is finalized; keep retrying them during an upgrade
pr:104500.rationale: Validation fails transiently only while the cluster version gate is being crossed, so after finalization retrying cannot help.
alternatives_rejected: Always treat validation errors as permanent
pr:104500.quote: This treats descriptor validation errors as permanent again once the cluster version is finalized; until then the schema changer keeps retrying them

pr:110500.choice: Run the strict planning sanity check only when sql.schemachanger.strict_planning_sanity_check.enabled is set, off by default in production
pr:110500.rationale: The check walks every stage of the plan and is too expensive to run on every statement in production.
pr:110500.quote: The schema changer plan sanity check walks every stage of the plan and is too expensive to run on every statement in production.

issue:98001.choice: Back off exponentially between schema change job retries instead of retrying immediately
issue:98001.rationale: A constant delay would still hammer the cluster during a long outage.
issue:98001.quote: We should back off exponentially between retries instead of retrying immediately; a constant delay would still hammer the cluster during a long outage.
